result.stdout:
Bielu.AspNetCore.AsyncApi CLI - Generate and merge AsyncAPI documents

Usage: dotnet asyncapi <command> [options]

Commands:
  getdocument    Generate AsyncAPI documents from ASP.NET Core applications
  merge          Merge multiple AsyncAPI documents into one

getdocument options:
  --assembly <name>        The assembly name to load (required)
  --assembly-path <path>   The full path to the assembly
  --output <dir>           The output directory for generated documents (required)
  --project <name>         The project name (used for file naming)
  --document <name>        Generate only the specified document
  --file-list <path>       Path to write the list of generated files
  --file-name <name>       Override file name (without extension)

merge options:
  --source <uri>           A document source URI - file path or URL (required, repeatable)
  --output <path>          The output file path for the merged document (required)
  --prefix <prefix>        Key prefix for the corresponding source (optional, repeatable)
  --title <title>          Title for the merged document
  --version <version>      Version for the merged document

  -h, --help               Show this help message
